posts.title: Zenovay: The Analytics Company That Doesn't Exist
posts.description: Zenovay presents itself as a Swiss, privacy-first analytics platform that has been operating since 2023. Every part of that is fabricated. Start with the timeline. Zenovay's own About page says the platform launched in 2023. A domain lookup shows zenovay.com wasn't registered until 2025-07-28. The company could not have launched a platform two years before its domain existed. The team is next. The
